notes.title: Crystal comet 1.0
notes.content:
Crystal Comet 1.0:

FUN STUFF:
- Added new music for the wyvern / dragon level. Wink wink.
- Added new priorities to the allied AI for where they should move & when.
- Updated Challenger ship's special effect to now only affect enemies within a radius of the ship but now also does damage per second & causes knockback.
- Buffed hover ship's special ability. Boom.
- Buffed speed demon ship's special ability - Ride the wave.
- Added a rumble to the previous special abilities on activation (for both) and added rumble duration for Amber's.
- Added rumble on activation for alien's special ability (rumble can be turned off via the menu).

MAJOR BUG FIX:
- Fixed an issue where the allied AI can continue playing without you in true last boss mode if you died...
- Fixed a bug where eyeball boss steam achievement was not being unlocked. 

MINOR BUG FIXES:
- Fixed level director not ambushing you when it is supposed to.. Again..
- Fixed an animation issue where small enemy books where not displaying their flying animation sometimes.
- Made some general minor optimisations.
- Fixed sound effect still playing from power up wand shot after bullet has hit a target or gone off-screen etc.
- Fixed bug where background was not scrolling during the "Bone boss".
- Fixed issue where music was cutting out too abruptly during TLB battle. It now fades between transitions.

MINOR CHANGES:
- Added animation to 'machines' level projectiles.
- Added animation to "orange" enemy projectiles during stealth level. Reference intended.
- Reduced the amount of invincibility frames a player/AI team mates receives when being hit in certain situations.
- Nerfed the allied AI's accuracy a little to make them more 'human'. Sounds minor but actually broke the entire game and took a while to fix. Dev life.
- Made some adjustments to how the allied AI move during dialogue scenes.
- Made some changes to the allied AI priority systems. Such as collecting things like health, powerups etc.
- Reduced a lot of particle effects that were causing some confusion.
- Changed the sprite for the shield power up before it is collected. Looked a bit too transformer like before.
- Updated a sprite for a certain enemy attack that shall remain nameless.. Reading this back now I don't even remember which one.
- Reduced some special FX for Amber's and XC69's special abilities as these were causing visibility issues.
- Reduced time to charge a 'charged shot' from 2 seconds to 1.5. Please refer to your instruction manual pilots.
- Changed an award on score screen from "Dead collector" to "Gem collector" - This was originally from when "Comet fragments" used to be "Kill tokens" - check previous patch notes for more on this.
- Reduced the speed demon's ship's special ability duration to compensate for the buff to the ability.
- Increased the speed of certain player bullets & power up bullets.
- Re-adjusted ship amount costs to unlock in random mode as players can get much more crystals or gems now.
- Alien ship's special ability now does poison burst damage at the end of the effect rather than damage over time now.
- Alien's slow time special ability now signals when the effect is over.

MAJOR CHANGE:
- Removed the following power ups from the true last boss mode: Decoy, freeze shot (or ray) & wand shot. They may be added back in at some point - Will see after testing & tweaking. They just don't feel 'fun' in that mode.

MINOR SCREW UPS:
- Fixed a missing quotation mark during the start of the dragon level during a dialogue.

NEXT WEEK ON I THINK IT'S KINDA DONE:
- Welp. I need to get to actually promoting this thing properly. I'll probably support the game after launch for ~1 month-ish. Unless it does really really well then I'd do a lot more with it: like localisation, console ports & additional enemies as well as bosses for random mode (which would mean a lot more other updates knowing me) - but we shall see what happens!

- I'm pretty happy with how the game has turned out, It has 3 modes separated by difficulty: story, random & the TLB (mode) without using difficulty sliders. It's almost like 3 games in one. Lots of characters to play as. Lots of replayability. Excellent music. Tense action & comedy. Voice acting. AI team mates. Branching paths. Multiple endings. etc. etc. etc.

- It's pretty much the game I wanted to exist that didn't until now. I think I've done enough to make a unique game for the players. It's sad it's coming to an end (for now) but it's been a long 3+ years: I have learned a lot more than I bargained for! Also, there's lots of other things I would love to make so stay tuned! - Plus a sequel one day would be nice.. ;).

- Special thanks to all the beta testers: You "rock".

notes.title: Crystal Comet 0.97.00.00:
notes.content:
[h1]FUN STUFF:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The TRUE LAST BOSS mode has been added to the game. Good luck, have fun..
[*] Added new music to the Dragon level. Uhm, I mean Wyvern level. 
[*] Added collision sounds into the game when attacking enemies. 
[*] Added new voice lines for character as more story elements have been added to the game. *Wink wink*.
[*] Added the ULTIMATE WEAPON power up to the game...
[*] Added two new achievements for true last boss and ultimate weapon power up unlock.
[*] I added a health bar to the game as requested because I am kind. You have to find it though..
[*] Added a leader board for the true last boss "mode" ;) ;).
[/list]

[h1]MAJOR ADJUSTMENTS:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Doubled freeze shot power up ammo from 20 to 40.
[*] Significantly reduced the health of a certain 'enemy' but can't tell you which type as it will spoil a surprise at the end of the game for other players..
[*] Improved shielded ship's special ability greatly. 
[*] Slightly reduced the duration of the shielded ships special ability.
[*] Increased laser gun powerup damage by 50%.
[/list]

[h1]SCORING SYSTEM CHANGES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dramatically increased score for repairing an allies downed ship.
[*] Increased score for collecting a power up.
[*] Increased score for using a special ability
[*] Increased score for boosting
[*] Increased score for warping
[*] Increased score for killing small, medium & large enemies
[*] Lowered score for landing final hit on a boss.
[*] Lowered score for hitting a boss although there was a bug in the previous version as this was not being calculated correctly. So it is pretty much the same..
[*] Increased scores for collecting small & medium energy cells or "batteries" as they are commonly referred to. They match the large energy collection score now.
[*] Increased score for collecting comet fragments
[*] Added new way to score: gain points for firing a charged shot (please refer to the instruction manual for what that is).
[*] I discovered a way to infinitely gain the scoring system which has now been fixed. Haha.
[*] Replaced hud section where it was displaying your kills. It now displays your current score to make it easier for players to figure out the score system as it was a bit too "well hidden" before. Multipliers will not be calculated until the score screen appears however.
[*] Added another place value to display score on hud to accommodate for the previous point.
[*] Have fun achieving a much higher score!!
[/list]

[h1]MINOR ADJUSTMENTS:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed initial comet fragments on leader board to be slightly lower.
[*] Changed text from main menu saying "START GAME" to "STORY MODE".
[*] Increased flash alpha when certain enemies get hit (only a little). There is an option to disable flashes via the menu.
[*] Added rumble effect when firing a charged shot. (rumble effects can be disabled via the menu).
[*] Adjusted alien, robot & Amber's ship's special abilities to balance with the true last boss mode.
[*] 
[*] [h1]SILLY MISTAKES I MADE:[/h1]
[*] Fixed the tips menu that appears when you fail a mission. Fun fact: Originally in the game there used to be "Kill tokens" which used to look like little terminator skulls. This was changed to "Comet fragments" as during the original play testing sessions players thought "Kill tokens" were enemies and would try to avoid them. Now everyone seems to know to collect the "Comet fragments" or "Gems" as they are commonly referred to now. Nice.
[*] Fixed a couple of other typo's in the tips menu but forgot which ones.
[/list]

[h1]THOSE BLOODY BUGS:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where laser gun power up was not awarding score when hitting bosses.
[*] Fixed a bug where bounce shot was not awarding score when hitting bosses.
[*] Fixed a bug where boss hits was being shown as the point score rather than the amount of hits actually done on the scoreboard.
[*] There was various other bug fixes I did which shouldn't affect the players as these were caused during the creation of the true last boss and the patch has only just gone live. If you encounter any issues please contact me as soon as possible. Cheers.
[/list]

[h1]NEXT WEEK ON "I THINK WE'RE GETTING SOMEWHERE":[/h1]
[list]
[*] Need to polish some areas of the game up.
[*] Go through previous beta feedback and make some changes. At least there's a harder mode now! Thanks guys!
[*] Go through feedback from true last boss once that starts coming through.
[*] Polish & finish the game... (won't be done by next week but that's the direction we're heading now! Yay!).
[/list]

notes.title: Closed beta patch: Crystal Comet 0.96.26.23:
notes.content:
Crystal Comet 0.96.26.23:

FUN STUFF:
- Added steam achievements to the game.
- Added a shader to bosses to show what phase they are in as players requested health bars but I like the old school super metroid style of showing boss phases. Although it's a bit different to that.
- Added menu item for true last boss to main menu although this will not be visible until unlocked and will not be selectable until the true last boss is added to the game (current working on it).

THE WORST KIND OF BUGS:
- Fixed error caused by last update which caused a crash (occasionally) when an AI team mate drops a power up for you. Was fixed & added in a shadow patch shortly after it was discovered after the last patch.

ANNOYING BUGS:
- Fixed issue related to music not being played in main menu after adjusting the music level briefly introduced since last patch..
- Fixed an issue where full-screen was running in windowed mode sometimes if the player had another application open as game loaded.

NEXT WEEK ON OH MY GOD THIS WILL NEVER END:
- Try and finish the "true last boss". I'm not sure if 3 weeks is actually enough time but will have to see what happens.

notes.title: Crystal Comet 0.96.26.16 update.
notes.content:
Crystal Comet 0.96.26.16:

FUN STUFF:
- Made menu more explosive: Added rumble to the explosions when selecting certain options.
- Replaced a mouth sound effect that was used as a placeholder *cough*. It was the spinning sound of the frozen Valkyrie's spear.

ACESSIBILITY THINGS:
- Created option to turn down / increase volume of dialogue.
- Added option to turn gamepad rumble on / off for xbox pads (other pads may or may not rumble depending on make).

ADJUSTMENTS:
- Adjusted spacing for Minime powerup and decoys as some players found it hard to tell whether they were shooting when they fly close to an allied players ship.
- Adjusted start volume of game as streamers were turning it down so that it is initially lower. You may need to go into options and adjust dialogue volume accordingly if you are in the closed beta.

ANNOYING BUGS:
- Fixed minor bug where when quit game prompt was active and selecting "no" to quit it would activate whatever menu item was currently highlighted by the menu selector.
- Fixed an issue where sometimes (rarely) pads would rumble and not stop.
- Fixed issue where mini-me powerup would jiggle when in position near a players/allies ship. 
- Fixed issue where allied AI were sometimes not dropping powerups for players when a player did not have one.
- Fixed layering issue related to bandit boss and mini-boss drawing at incorrect depths.
- Fixed bug where level ambience background music was being treated as SFX voume and would play at the incorrect vaules - Audio bugs are literally the worst.
- Fixed issue where correct achievement icons (based on achievement type) where not being drawn via in game achievement system and was just drawing a default icon.

NEXT WEEK ON LET'S GET THIS GAME DONE & STOP MESSING AROUND:
- Add steam achievements to in game achievement system...
- Start work on true last boss.

notes.title: Crystal Comet 0.96.26.11: Closed beta weekly update patch.
notes.content:
[h1]Crystal Comet 0.96.26.11:[/h1]

[h2]FUN STUFF:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made mine boss more fun xD. Now it fires more projectiles. Yay.
[*] Changed main menu when 'first' ever loading the game as I feel this tells a better story. Will not appear if have already beaten the game.
[/list]

[h2]ANNOYING BUGS AND STUFF:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made it so that P1 HuD location in game is top left, P2 location is top right, P3 is bottom left etc as this was highly requested.
[*] Fixed minor bug with robot boss related to enemy spawners entering destroyed state when not supposed to. You're in trouble now... Ahh it's not that bad. Promise...
[*] Fixed minor bug where bone boss would go too far off-screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where magic boss would go too far off-screen, which I thought was already fixed. Still needs some work but will get back to it.
[*] Fixed minor bug where bone mini-boss would go too far off-screen. Think I'm starting to notice a pattern here..
[*] Fixed minor bug where screen displays in random mode menu where not displaying certain players choices of character in 2-4 player modes.
[*] Fixed a bug where backing out of the "launching" display during random mode would cause the AI not to select a character.
[*] Fixed an issue where setting a button input to "Press left stick" or "Press right stick" would cause the text to run past the menu. It now displays "L3" or "R3" respectively.
[*] Changed the way dropping in and dropping out works slightly. It wasn't really a bug but I changed menu items to use state machines as opposed to just if statements which solved various issues but remembering them all might be a problem..
[*] Fixed optimisation by 0.001%. Just kidding, I don't how much by.
[/list]

[h2]THE WORST KIND OF BUGS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which causes a crash when a controller is disconnected... Don't need that in local co-op games now do we? Thanks to csh_picone for finding that one 8).
[*] Fixed bug where crash occurred when backing out of countdown when in random mode after selecting characters in multiplayer. Thanks again picone. xD.
[/list]

[h2]NEXT WEEK ON REWDAN HATES BUGS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix some more minor issues with remapping controls, such as multi-key assignment. Remind me to never code my own controller remapping scheme ever again.
[*] Add steam achievements and tie to in game achievement system... One day.
[/list]

[h3]PS: If you have any problems with the current closed beta build please reach out to me. Thank you.[/h3]

notes.title: WARNING WARNING. emergency patch incoming! Crystal Comet: v0.96.26.04.
notes.content:
Crystal Comet 0.96.26.04:

FUN STUFF:
- Add a new phase to the eyeball boss. Eye'ight? 
- Decided to leave robot boss alone for now as players seem to like that one: "if it ain't broke, don't fix it". Although may come back to that one as noticed a couple of issues on my end.

ANNOYING BUGS AND STUFF:
- Fixed a bug where setting "Fire front guns" via controller remapping to left mouse button would make it so that keyboard could use any key to fire front guns as well... Sigh. Thus causing a kind of "auto fire" situation...
- Wrote a bunch of de-bug code which then had to be de-bugged.
- Checked assigning other actions to left mouse button does not cause similar issues. If you have any problems please let me know!
- Fixed issue where changing fire top guns to right trigger would tie it to the warp as well.

THE WORST KIND OF BUGS:
- Fixed a bug related to mouse cursor causing game to crash on death (thanks VanAlphen for finding that!). 

THIS WEEK ON REWDAN SCREWS UP GAME DEV:
- Still working on some issues related to mouse and keyboard / controller rebindings. There may be some issues as I fix and change things around.
- I have plans to add more fun stuff but bugs need to be DESTROYED.

notes.title: Weekly update: Crystal Comet 0.96.25.99. (Closed Beta).
notes.content:
Crystal Comet 0.96.25.99:

FUN STUFF:
- Fixed Amber's special ability in final battle. Good luck.
- Made explosive shot powerup more fun.
- Made bone shot powerup... Longer.
- Made dragon shot powerup viable.
- Added ability to take screen shots for steam using f12.
- Added "Thank you for playing!" to end of credits. 

ANNOYING BUGS AND STUFF:
- Fixed bug where if auto target was enabled using mouse and keyboard controls (by setting fire top gun action to any keyboard button instead of the mouse) the player would get unlimited ammo whilst using the missile launcher..
- Updated text which said "FIRE TOP GUNS" to "FIRE TOP GUN" when in the rebinding controls menu.
- Renamed achievement from "I only need one credit" to "We only need one credit".
- Fixed a bug where custom control schemes were not being loaded when dropping into a game and the player assumes control of a character and the defaults were being loaded instead.
- Fixed a bug where custom control schemes were not being loaded in the final battle.
- Fixed a bug where auto target does not work when switching from mouse button press to keyboard button press using custom controls in final battle.
- Fixed an issue where custom control schemes were not loading for player ships etc during final battle.
- Fixed an issue where using auto target via setting custom control scheme to not be mouse controls or right stick controls was not working in final battle.
- Added an 'additional' cross hair target when using mouse and keyboard controls so players know top gun controls are tied to the mouse cursor position. It looks way cooler now 8). You may have to adjust mouse sensitivity if controls don't feel right. If that's not good enough contact me and I will look into improving it even further. Cheers!
- Made Magic boss not trap Ally AI teammates in corners... As much.

NEXT WEEK ON REWDAN SCREWS UP GAME DEV:
- I will be working on fixing controller/keyboard remapping if you are currently experiencing issues set it to "default". Also report in for duty with any bugs to me. Cheers.
- I'd like to add steam achievements at some point this year. The year's nearly over so don't @ me.
- I'd like to make the mine boss more... You'll see.
- Same with the Robot boss.

notes.title: Crystal Comet 0.96.25.97:
notes.content:
Crystal Comet 0.96.25.97:

notes.title: Crystal Comet 0.96.25.95 & .96
notes.content:
CURRENT CHANGES:

 Crystal Comet 0.96.25.95
- Updated ally AI a little. There are some bosses they struggle against but I think that is ok. There wouldn't be much tension if the ally AI never went "down" during combat. They are a tiny bit smarter now during certain bosses.
- Added outline for players ships (thanks Sean Spalding).
- Updated the UI notifications for enemies to not grow as big as they were. They now start at 0% size then increase to 100% and increase in alpha so they don't clutter the screen as much.
- Fixed game breaking bug which caused a crash when entering the "final battle" when using mouse and keyboard controls. Oof. Brutal!
- Tweaked mouse and keyboard controls as they were a bit jank.
- Made power ups no longer go off screen when heading towards the left and right side of the screen.
- Reduced Amber's special ability from 60 frames to 50 frames.
- Made drops stay with screen instead of sometimes half being outside of the screen area on spawn only.

Crystal Comet 0.96.25.96: Umm... Disabled the developer console. No cheating for you.

notes.content:
